The '''High Ontis''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] chain that was located in the equatorial region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. The remote canyons of the High Ontis contained a number of [[Marble/Legends|marble]] quarries that were known as the "jumper quarries," due to the fact that their ownership status was contested for centuries. A number of alpine lakes were also located within the mountain chain.<ref name="CatCW" />
